plain: A writer on ancient civilisations, Graham Hancock, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2024 about an old belief he calls the path of souls. In this belief, a dead person's soul leaps up to the star pattern Orion and then travels along the Milky Way, and Hancock says the idea is found in North, Central and South America, a theme he links to his television series Ancient Apocalypse. He tells it because a shared star map of the afterlife across distant peoples would suggest a common ancient source.
